notes: Detector class label -> simulated elemental composition, used by the console's analysis panel.
THIS IS A SIMULATION, NOT A MEASUREMENT. The console does not carry a spectrometer.
Each entry is a preset chosen when the arena was prepared, standing in for an
instrument like APXS or PIXL on a real rover (proposal 5.4). The percentages below
are plausible for the named mineral class and are illustrative only -- they are not
assay data and must never be presented as such.
Keys are the class labels the camera detector was trained on (vision/detect_stream.py
reports them as `label`), matched case-insensitively. Edit this per arena setup with
no retraining and no reflashing: point COMPOSITION_TABLE at another file to override,
Labels are never shown on screen: the console says OBJECT DETECTED, and `name`
below is revealed only when the operator's analysis completes. A label with no
entry here is analysed as "Unclassified sample", flagged amber, and the label is
printed to the console's output so this file can be fixed.
Percentages are by mass and should total about 100.
Format 2 (2026-09-26): keyed by detector label. Format 1 was keyed by RFID tag EPC,
which the mission no longer uses.
